title: Variational valued at $1.5B, Kraken's parent buys Tribe Capital, Ark buys crypto stocks
caption:
deal flow 🏦 onchain derivatives platform variational raised $110m at a $1.5b valuation, led by bain capital crypto. its omni platform has done $475b+ in volume, over half from traditional markets. kraken parent payward agreed to buy tribe capital ($2.7b aum), closing expected q1 2027. ark bought block, circle and coinbase shares while selling ~$85m of nvidia. are stocks and crypto merging into one venue? 👇 not financial advice.
